snippet.title: Nutmeg! Gameplay Reveal - 2025 Convergence Games Showcase
snippet.description:
NUTMEG! A Deckbuilding Retro Football Manager is a nostalgic football manager game with a deckbuilding twist, set in the '80s and '90s. Relive the days when the tackles were as hard as the mullets were long and football was about football, in this exclusive gameplay clip which debuted in the 2025 Convergence Gaming Showcase.

Wishlist the game on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3590560
